general.title: General
general.subtitle: How LastSave looks, and how it behaves towards Windows.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language LastSave speaks. More are on the way.

languageStudio.title: Language Studio
languageStudio.description: Improve this translation or create one for your language, with LastSave in view.
languageStudio.keywords: translate, translation, language, studio, localization, localize

tray.title: Minimise to the system tray
tray.description: Closing the window keeps LastSave running in the tray, so it can still detect your play sessions.

openAtLogin.title: Open LastSave when Windows starts
openAtLogin.description: Signs you in with the app already running, so nothing has to be launched before a session can be detected.

startMinimized.title: Start minimised
startMinimized.description: A startup launch goes straight to the system tray instead of opening the window in front of you.

general.startupDevNote: Development build: the preference is saved, but no Windows startup entry is written until LastSave is installed.

tips.title: Show tips automatically
tips.description: The getting-started guide, first-time tips and the in-game quest. Help keeps working either way.
tips.keywords: help, tutorial, tour, onboarding, hints, guide

guide.title: Getting started guide
guide.description: The six steps that show you the basics. Bring it back if you hid it.

resetHelp.title: Reset help progress
resetHelp.description: Clears what you marked as known and the tips you have already seen. What you did in your library stays ticked.

playing.title: Playing
playing.subtitle: What happens when you press Play. Every game keeps its own setting underneath these.

tracking.title: Track play sessions
tracking.description: Times your games, notices when they start and keeps a history of each session. Turn it off to use LastSave only to organize and launch. Every game keeps its own tracking setting for when this is back on.

launching.title: Launch games from LastSave
launching.description: Opens the game when you press Play. Turn it off to start your games yourself: every one of them offers Start (timer only) instead. Each game keeps its own launch setting for when this is back on.

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.subtitle: The panel LastSave draws over your game while a session is running.

corner.title: Overlay position
corner.description: Where the overlay sits until you drag it. Dragging the expanded panel moves the compact one too.

sounds.title: Overlay sounds
sounds.description: Short cues for screenshots, notes, pause and resume.

gaming.title: Game Mode
gaming.subtitle: The controller-first view of your library.

glyphs.title: Button prompts
glyphs.description: Which controller’s buttons Game Mode draws. Automatic follows the controller in your hands.
glyphs.keywords: glyphs, icons, prompts, buttons, xbox, playstation, switch, controller, gamepad

sounds.title: Game Mode sounds
sounds.description: Short cues when you move, open the menu, and enter or leave Game Mode.

reduceMotion.title: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: No growing, sliding or crossfading, and clips play only when you watch them. System follows Windows’ animation effects.
reduceMotion.keywords: motion, animation, animations, accessibility, reduce, still, transitions

captures.title: Captures & clips
captures.subtitle: What LastSave records while you play, and where it looks for it.

format.title: Screenshot format
format.description: JPEG keeps a 1440p shot under 1 MB; PNG is lossless and several times larger.

recorder.title: Clip recorder
recorder.description: LastSave records nothing itself: it presses the recorder's hotkey and imports the file it writes.
recorder.keywords: game bar, nvidia, amd, replay, record

nvidiaFolder.title: NVIDIA clips folder
nvidiaFolder.description: Where the NVIDIA overlay saves clips, if you moved it from Videos.

extraFolder.title: Extra clips folder
extraFolder.description: Any other folder to watch for clips while you play.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: The chords Playing Mode listens for while a session is running, on the keyboard and on a controller.
shortcuts.unavailable: {{accelerator}} is held by another app while playing. Choose a different chord.

capture.taken: Another app already holds that chord.
capture.bareKey: A key with no modifier stops reaching other apps while you play.
capture.padTaken: That chord could not be saved.

overlay.title: Show or minimize the overlay
overlay.description: Switches the overlay between the pill and the full panel.

focus.title: Focus mode
focus.description: Steps out of the game: dims the screen, frees the mouse, and lets you file captures in place. Press again or Esc to return.

hide.title: Hide or show the overlay
hide.description: Takes the overlay off the screen, pill included, and brings it back.

screenshot.title: Screenshot
screenshot.description: Captures the game and keeps it with the session.

quickJournal.title: Add a note
quickJournal.description: Opens the one-line note on the overlay. Pressed right after a capture, it files that capture instead.

pause.title: Pause or resume
pause.description: Stops the clock without ending the session.

stop.title: End the session
stop.description: Brings LastSave forward and asks before ending anything.

clip.title: Clip the last seconds
clip.description: Asks Game Bar or NVIDIA for the replay it has been holding.

record.title: Record
record.description: Starts and stops a recording through your capture tool.

padCaptureDelay.title: Controller screenshot delay
padCaptureDelay.description: A screenshot from a controller chord waits this long, so you can close whatever the chord opened in the game. Pressing the chord again takes it at once. Recordings and keyboard shortcuts never wait.
padCaptureDelay.keywords: controller pad delay countdown timer screenshot capture menu map

games.title: Games & scanning
games.subtitle: What LastSave reads on this machine when it looks for your games.

lookupFolders.title: Windows lookup folders
lookupFolders.description: Extra folders to search for Windows game shortcuts and executables beyond the default desktop, Start Menu, and launcher paths.

startupCheck.title: Check on startup
startupCheck.description: Once a day, the first time LastSave opens, look for games you don't have yet. It only tells you when it finds something new.

games.foldersRestored: Windows lookup folders restored to defaults.

emulators.title: Emulators
emulators.subtitle: The emulators LastSave plays your ROMs with, and where it finds those ROMs.

romSetup.title: Emulators and ROM folders
romSetup.description: Point LastSave at each emulator's executable and the folders that hold its ROMs.
romSetup.keywords: roms, retroarch, cores, emulation, pcsx2, dolphin, rpcs3, duckstation, ppsspp, bios, systems

art.title: Art
art.subtitle: The banners and logos LastSave shows for your games.

heroes.title: Banners from SteamGridDB
heroes.description: Wide art behind each game, from the SteamGridDB community or Steam's store. Off, games use their catalog art. A game's own choice (Manage → Art) comes first.
heroes.keywords: banner, hero, background, art, artwork, steamgriddb, steam, igdb, wallpaper

logos.title: Game logos
logos.description: Each game's logo instead of its name in type, from SteamGridDB or Steam. A game's own choice (Manage → Art) comes first.
logos.keywords: logo, title, name, art, steamgriddb, steam

art.credit: Banners and logos come from <brand>SteamGridDB</brand>, where the community makes and shares them, and from Steam's store art. LastSave is independent and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by SteamGridDB, Valve, or the games' developers and publishers.

data.title: Data
data.subtitle: Where your data lives, and how to clear it.

database.title: Database
database.description: Location of your local SQLite database.

mediaFolder.title: Media folder
mediaFolder.description: Where screenshots, clips, log images and share files are saved. Your library's database stays where it is.
mediaFolder.keywords: media, folder, disk, drive, screenshots, clips, videos, captures, storage, space, move, location, path
mediaFolder.unavailable: Not available. New media is saved in the default folder until it's back.
mediaFolder.pickTitle: Choose a folder for your media
mediaFolder.chosen: New media will be saved in this folder.
mediaFolder.located: Found it. That media shows again.

dialog.title: Save new media here?
dialog.message: New screenshots, clips, images and share files will be saved in {{folder}}.
dialog.stays: What you already have stays where it is and keeps showing in your logs.
dialog.movable_one: You have {{size}} of media in other folders ({{count}} file). You can move it here too.
dialog.movable_other: You have {{size}} of media in other folders ({{count}} files). You can move it here too.
dialog.noSpace: This disk has {{free}} free, which isn't enough to move all of it.
dialog.moveMessage_one: {{size}} in {{count}} file will be copied to {{folder}}, checked, and then removed from where it is now.
dialog.moveMessage_other: {{size}} in {{count}} files will be copied to {{folder}}, checked, and then removed from where it is now.
dialog.moveSafe: Nothing changes until every file is copied. You can pause or cancel at any time, and if LastSave closes it carries on next time.

move.done: All your media is in this folder now.
move.cancelled: Move cancelled. Your media stayed where it was.

failed.noSpace: Not enough space: the move needs {{size}} free on that disk. Nothing was changed.
failed.conflict: This folder already has a different file with the same name, so the move stopped. Nothing was changed.
failed.copyFailed: Some files couldn't be copied. Nothing was changed. Try again.
failed.destinationMissing: The folder isn't available any more. Plug the disk back in and try again. Nothing was changed.

refusal.notWritable: LastSave can't save files in that folder.
refusal.insideAppData: That folder is inside LastSave's own data. Pick another one.
refusal.nested: That folder is inside another media folder, or holds one. Pick another one.
refusal.moveRunning: Wait for the move to finish, or cancel it first.
refusal.sessionLive: Finish the session you're playing first.
refusal.importRunning: An import is still running. Let it finish first.
refusal.nothingToMove: There's nothing to move. All your media is already here.
refusal.notRecognized: That doesn't look like this media folder. Pick the folder you moved.

backups.title: Restore a backup
backups.description: LastSave keeps a copy of your library before every update and once a day, here on your PC.
backups.keywords: backup, restore, copy, undo, recover, rollback, update
backups.confirmMessage: LastSave will restart with your library as it was on {{date}}.
backups.replaces: Anything you did after that is replaced: games, logs, sessions and settings.
backups.keeps: Your current library is saved as a backup first, so you can come back to it.
backups.media: Screenshots and clips stay on disk as they are now.

refusal.missing: That backup is no longer there.
refusal.invalid: That backup can't be read, so it wasn't restored.
refusal.tooNew: That backup is from a newer LastSave. Update LastSave to restore it.

igdbCache.title: IGDB cache
igdbCache.description: Clear cached IGDB rails, picker data, and game details.

usageCounts.title: Count this installation
usageCounts.description: Adds an anonymous ID to LastSave's requests for game info and art, so we can count installs and catch problems. Your library and activity are never sent.
usageCounts.keywords: telemetry, analytics, usage, statistics, privacy, anonymous, id, tracking, opt out

resetLibrary.title: Reset library
resetLibrary.description: Deletes every game, log, session, note, capture and shelf, and leaves LastSave the way it was the day you installed it — with your profile.
resetLibrary.keywords: start over, wipe, delete library, empty, clean
resetLibrary.confirmMessage: This cannot be undone. LastSave will restart its window once it is done.
resetLibrary.keeps: Kept: your profile and nickname, every setting on these pages, and your Steam, Epic and Xbox connections.
resetLibrary.removes: Removed: your games, logs, sessions, journal entries, achievements, screenshots, clips and shelves.
resetLibrary.acknowledge: I understand this cannot be undone.
resetLibrary.failed: The library could not be reset.

clearEverything.title: Clear everything
clearEverything.description: Deletes the whole database, your profile and every stored file, then restarts LastSave as a brand new installation.
clearEverything.keywords: factory reset, uninstall, erase, fresh start
clearEverything.confirmTitle: Clear everything and start from zero?
clearEverything.confirmMessage: LastSave will close, delete its data and open again at the welcome screen.
clearEverything.removes: Removed: your profile, your library, every setting, your Steam, Epic and Xbox connections, every screenshot and clip LastSave is keeping, and its backups.
clearEverything.acknowledge: I understand this deletes everything, including my profile.
clearEverything.failed: LastSave could not clear its data.

refusal.sessionLive: Finish the session you are playing first — it has not been written yet.
refusal.importRunning: An import is still running. Let it finish first.
refusal.mediaMoving: Your media is being moved. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it first.
